# SUMMARY: Gene expression profiling of NSCLC tissues let to the establishment of several prognostic
column2: predictive gene signatures with little overlap. To study factors introducing variability into gene expression microarray studies we compared interpatient (patient-to-patient) and intrapatient (tumor sub-sample) variations in gene expression profiles in stage I and II NSCLC tissues. We identified 128 probe sets which showed variable intratumoral expression
